name: Strata design guidelines
description: Machine-readable evaluation criteria for Strata. Each criterion is a discrete yes/no check with a mode: 'automated' (a lint/test can verify), 'llm' (an agent/LLM self-check), or 'human' (requires design judgment).

criteria.check: A first-time viewer can name the primary action within 5 seconds
Exactly one primary action per region; secondary actions are visually quieter
Reading only type styles (ignoring content) reconstructs the page structure
Exactly one dominant element; no competing emphasis
All numeric columns right-align; labels left-align
Deltas use semantic color, and color is never the only signal
Every data region has an empty and a loading state
Errors explain what happened and the next step
Every animation has a stated reason
Full keyboard path through every component (Base UI primitives)
Visible focus ring; contrast meets AA

principles.name: Tokens are the only source of truth

criteria.check: No literal hex/px/shadow values in component CSS
New values are added to tokens/*.json, not inline
